description.text: Mega Battle Deck 60: M Rayquaza-EX, a ready-built 60-card deck released on 14 March 2015 ahead of the Rayquaza Mega Battle event in May, built around Rayquaza-EX and M Rayquaza-EX. It holds Rayquaza Spirit Link, which keeps the turn going when Rayquaza-EX Mega Evolves and was otherwise only given in a campaign, so players building other Rayquaza decks wanted it too. A playmat, a coin, damage counters and markers, a rule book and a battle master guide came with it.
